text: Racks of new ironwork stand outside the workshops, waiting for the carts.
whys: c: racks of new ironwork waiting for carts, yet the page says war has taken the iron and smiths have nothing; Blacksmiths curtailed (other: C7477)

text: Whatever crime is organised at Eisenmark has no rival, and no crew is contesting the streets with it.
whys: c: says organised crime has no rival and no crew contests the streets; same tab says semi-organized networks lacking a single authority, several gangs competing (other: C8625)
(LOW by the first pair) a: says no crew contests organised crime; Criminal structure line says several gangs may be competing, no single controlling authority
(LOW by the first pair) b: says crime has no rival and no crew contests the streets; same tab says several gangs may be competing

text: Wants Buy stone and iron and grain at the market in bulk this season, while the price is still fair.
whys: c: wants to buy stone and iron at fair prices; page says stone is needed and not brought in, war has taken the iron, prices keep rising (other: C8191)

text: Crown-appointed emergency body with powers over requisition, conscription, and price controls.
whys: c: Martial Alliance card given the War Council's description (crown-appointed emergency body over requisition and conscription); two powers, one text (other: C14088)
(LOW by the first pair) a: The Martial Alliance card prints the War Council's crown-appointed requisition body text; the Alliance is a separate power led by castellan and lanista
(LOW by the first pair) b: The Martial Alliance card prints the War Council's description (crown-appointed emergency body for requisition); same text sits under War Council at C14088

text: At Khutulunnuur the hamlet's business goes to the whole Headman's Authority, and everybody has learned how long the answer takes.
whys: c: business goes to 'the whole' Headman's Authority, slow to answer; the authority is one acknowledged headman deciding without ceremony (other: C16513)

text: People at Khutulunnuur may grumble, but nobody in the hamlet stands ready to lead them against the Headman's Authority.
whys: c: only grumbling, nobody to lead against the rulers; TENSIONS give a live popular uprising pressing those in charge (other: C16458)
c: origin says the road came first and the hamlet grew on its verge; FOUNDING says it began as a mining camp
c: mill access marked Stopped by the siege, yet its own row Grain milling is printed on offer with no mark (other: C18382)

text: Áine MacDonald is third in Feudal Stewardship and holds a half share in War Council, and carries War Council's requests to the two above.
whys: c: Aine said to hold a half share in War Council, but War Council has one member, Aine herself (PEOPLE: rank 1) (other: C18556)
c: Invasion & War rated Adequate; DEFENCE gives no wall and no force of any kind, and the next line says no line and no force (other: C18613)
c: Fish 'Fully exploited' but HOUSES has no fishing house and LAND has no fishing chain; only subsistence farming works the land

text: The forges of Ulaanabad are quiet more often than not, for want of iron.
whys: c: forges idle for want of iron, but TRADE imports iron ore (mines exhausted) and no siege shuts the town

text: Ulaanabad covers what it must and nothing beyond.
whys: c: 'every essential is accounted for' in a town with a food gap and stone needed but not brought in (other: C38487)
